test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**which**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank requires a relative pronoun to connect “the ways” to the clause describing how climate change is intertwined with other issues.
 
• "**Which**" is the correct relative pronoun when referring to “ways” in the phrase “the ways in which.”
 
• Other options (“whose”, “whom”, “that”) do not form the standard and correct phrase for this context.
 
• “In which” is the idiomatic and grammatically correct combination here.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Given the amount of 1. denial__ and misunderstanding surrounding the climate crisis, 2. __wholehearted__ climate education and engagement are fundamental to addressing the root causes of climate change. We need education not only based 3. __on__ climate science but also on the ways in 4. __which__ climate change is deeply intertwined with a range of other social, racial and environmental issues that 5. __shape__ our daily life experiences.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Whose: Refers to possession, not suitable for connecting “ways” to a descriptive clause.
 
• Whom: Used for people as the object of a verb or preposition, not appropriate here.
 
• That: Sometimes used as a relative pronoun, but “the ways in that…” is not standard English.
